# Living Rhea — Dr. Rhea Mehta

Dr. Rhea Mehta is a PhD toxicologist, holistic health coach, and modern medicine
woman — blending nutrition science, detox, fertility & postpartum support,
Himalayan breathwork, and sound/mantra work.
